setup.text: First Week Hunt. Your first week at Northbridge, and the office hides 8 security risks among safe look-alikes. Take turns tapping spots. A real risk scores 150 and you go again. A safe spot passes the turn. Two safe spots in a row and you get hacked: your score resets to zero. Each player gets one Shield hint.

setup-go.text: Pick how many players, tap a card to rename it, then press Start.

turn.text: Tap any spot in the office that looks like a security risk.

office.text: Here are the spots in the office.

hint.text: Look at the highlighted spot. Think:

hint-again.text: You missed one like this earlier, so this one is for you.

hacked.text: You got hacked! Two wrong taps in a row, so your score resets to zero. Start over!

warn.text: Careful: that was a decoy. One more wrong tap in a row and you get hacked.

board.text: That is the final leaderboard. Tap Shield debrief to see what each player should practice.

debrief.text: Shield debrief. Here is what each player should practice next.

rules.text: Plus 150 per risk. Your one hint costs 50. Two decoys in a row resets your score to zero.

tile-sticky.text: Monitor with a yellow note: "pw: Spring2026!"

tile-laptop.text: Empty desk, laptop open on email

tile-usb.text: USB stick on the lobby floor, labelled "Salaries"

tile-qr.text: Flyer: "Scan for free parking", QR sticker taped on top

tile-tailgate.text: Stranger with two coffees: "Hold the door, I'm late!"

tile-post.text: Coworker's phone post: new badge photo, "first day!"

tile-update.text: Banner: "Security update ready" (Remind me later x5)

tile-mfa.text: Phone: "Approve sign-in?" and you did not just sign in

tile-locked.text: Empty desk, laptop on its lock screen

tile-shred.text: Locked shred bin by the copier

tile-badge.text: Coworker taps their own badge at the door

tile-printer.text: Printer that holds jobs until you badge in

tile-photo.text: Team photo on the wall, no badges or screens

tile-mfaok.text: MFA prompt right after you signed in yourself

flag-sticky.text: A password on a sticky note: anyone walking past can read it.

flag-laptop.text: An unlocked laptop lets anyone send mail or open files as you.

flag-usb.text: A found USB stick is a classic bait drop; plugging it in can run malware.

flag-qr.text: The sticker QR goes to northbr1dge-parking.co, a look-alike login page.

flag-tailgate.text: Tailgating: hurry plus full hands gets people through a badge door without a badge.

flag-post.text: A clear badge photo lets someone print a copy and learn your name and team.

flag-update.text: Skipped security updates leave known holes open on your laptop.

flag-mfa.text: An MFA prompt you did not start means someone else has your password.

flag-locked.text: Fine: the laptop is locked, so nobody can use it.

flag-shred.text: Fine: papers with names and numbers go in the locked shred bin.

flag-poster.text: Fine: help.northbridge.co is the real Northbridge domain.

flag-badge.text: Fine: everyone badging in on their own is how the door should work.

flag-printer.text: Fine: secure print release keeps documents off the tray until you arrive.

flag-photo.text: Fine: a team photo with no badges, screens or plans gives nothing away.

flag-restart.text: Fine: an update installing is exactly what you want.

flag-mfaok.text: Fine: you just signed in, so this prompt is yours to approve.

tip-urgency.text: Pressure to act right now is a red flag. Slow down and verify through a channel you already trust.

tip-lookalike.text: Read web addresses letter by letter; northbridge.co is the only real one.

tip-credential.text: Passwords live in the password manager, never on paper or in a link you were sent.

tip-giftcard.text: Real managers never ask you to buy gift cards. Call them on a number you already have.

tip-attachment.text: Unknown files and found USB sticks go to IT unopened.

tip-mfa.text: Only approve an MFA prompt you just triggered yourself; deny and report the rest.

tip-oversharing.text: Badges, screens and travel plans help attackers. Keep them off public posts.

tip-device.text: Lock your screen when you step away and install updates when they are offered.

habit-sticky.text: Safe habit: Keep passwords in the Northbridge password manager, never on paper.

habit-laptop.text: Safe habit: Press Windows+L (or Ctrl+Cmd+Q on a Mac) every time you stand up.

habit-usb.text: Safe habit: Hand found drives to IT unplugged.

habit-qr.text: Safe habit: Type northbridge.co yourself instead of scanning stray QR codes.

habit-tailgate.text: Safe habit: Let the door close; point them to reception to sign in.

habit-post.text: Safe habit: Post the excitement, not the badge or your screen.

habit-update.text: Safe habit: Install updates when they are offered, or schedule them for tonight.

habit-mfa.text: Safe habit: Tap Deny, then report it and change your password.

habit-locked.text: Safe habit: This is the habit: lock it every time you step away.

habit-shred.text: Safe habit: Shred printouts with customer or login details.

habit-poster.text: Safe habit: Check the domain letter by letter; this one matches.

habit-badge.text: Safe habit: One person, one badge tap.

habit-printer.text: Safe habit: Use badge release for anything sensitive.

habit-photo.text: Safe habit: Check the background before you post a photo.

habit-restart.text: Safe habit: Let updates finish; save your work first.

habit-mfaok.text: Safe habit: Approve only prompts that match what you just did.
